_about: The standard exit table of the blueprint: 8 stops x 6 targets = 48 exit cells, the same for every idea. Cells in table order: FIRST the 32 cells of the old library's menu (engine/l2sim.py MENU_*, menu(root): stops outer -- `stop_order`, then the listed values -- targets `targets_r` inner), THEN the same 8 stops x `small_targets_r` (BLUEPRINT.md version 1.1, the owner 2026-10-06), so a store of the 32 keeps its cells and their order (engine/families/blocks.py menu_blueprint; run_menus runs every cell with hold = day). A stop is ATR x (Wilder ATR14 on the idea's bar size), fixed points per market, or percent of the entry price; a target is reward:risk from the stop distance, 0 = no target (the trade runs to its stop or to the flat time). Nobody adds or changes a cell after seeing a result. Locked to the engine by tests/test_blueprint_rules.py.
text: Variants = the standard exit table (8 stops × 6 targets) × the 3-4 values of the idea's main setting.
